name: fiction_multifact_continuity
description: Multi-fact fiction continuity smoke test: PASS requires classifying a direct contradiction, compatible new detail, and unresolved unknowns separately. Automated scoring uses evidence phrases and does not fully validate reasoning.

messages.content: You are a careful fiction continuity editor. Classify each item as contradiction, compatible new information, or unresolved unknown. Use only the provided facts. Include concise evidence and never promote an unknown to established canon.

Canon: Ilyan is left-handed and always writes with his left hand. His coat has not been established. A sealed package arrived, but its sender is unknown. Ilyan has a brass key whose lock has never been identified or tested.

Passage: Ilyan signed the treaty with his right hand. He wore a dark green coat. The package had no return address. He held the brass key near the cellar door, but did not insert it or test it.

Classify the hand use, coat, package sender, and key function. Do not rewrite the passage.
